messages.subject: Quantification
parts:
Hello,

I have not worked with MSI data for a few years, and therefore not used Cardinal recently either.

For untargeted MSI without quant I found the package super useful, however I was wondering if there are any workflows/functionalities for quantification. I believe, the existing functionalities can be extended if not, however if anyone could direct me towards a robust quantification workflow that would be very much appreciated.

Best wishes,
Matt

messages.author: 838579b7ba7e3ba2
messages.subject: Re: Quantification
parts:
Hi Matt,

I think it is possible with Cardinal (I have never done any quantitative MSI experiments.)

You can first use selectROI() to select the areas of internal standards, and calculate the mean ion intensities of each IS of different concentration levels. You can use combine() and aggregate() function to do that. Alternatively, you can calculate the mean intensity one by one.

Next you can build a calibration curve using the mean intensity values.   lm() should work. If your concentration ranges are very large, you may need consider weighting factor as well for linear regression. 

Finally you can quantify your msiData. I think you only need to quality the min and max ion intensities (which will be shown in the image color bar) of the mass features of interest. Just make sure they are within your IS concentration range. 

Hope it helps.

Best,

Dong
